final_draft.answer: As observed on 2026-11-16 (17:04 UTC), the password policy for IAM users in AWS account 111122223333 requires a minimum length of 8 characters. Passwords do not expire.
final_draft.note: Please check this before sending. The live check on 2026-11-16 found something different: a minimum of 8 characters and no expiry. I didn't use the approved wording because the account doesn't currently match it. The answer above reports what the live check found. The approved answer's owner needs to decide which is right: either change the AWS password policy to 14 characters and 90-day expiry, or update the approved answer. If the policy is fixed before this goes out, run the check again and update the answer.
